title: Persistent Twin Command Centre & Mechanistic Integration
based_on: AGROLATTICE 11.8 — Field Command Centre & Operations Polish
database_migration: Additive AgroLattice Twin 3.0.0 migration. Pre-11.9 backup + legacy-row equivalence + integrity/foreign-key verification.
performance_guards: No automatic NASA POWER request on Twin entry
No automatic Sentinel/STAC request or raster processing on Twin entry
No automatic crop-model calibration on Twin entry
No automatic scenario optimisation on Twin entry
Spatial map built only in Spatial Twin view
limitations: The Laurent-derived MFS implementation is not the publication's proprietary C++ Bayesian sampler and does not reproduce proprietary data.
Parameter-uncertainty date intervals require weather coverage sufficient to reach simulated events.
Flowering timing does not guarantee pollen quantity, seed purity or yield.
Full interactive Streamlit browser testing requires the user's installed Windows/Anaconda environment.
